period: previous complete Brisbane calendar month by citation publication date
states: Acquire unique month/query-version run record with concurrency one
Collect source observations into a versioned batch; upsert stable identifiers without resetting FirstObservedAtUTC
Freeze validated source batch and canonical review decisions
Request model refresh and persist a supported correlation marker
Verify completion of that exact refresh; otherwise require manual verification and stop unattended execution
Verify model batch, reporting month, source health and coverage
Extract full canonical register and selected-month register with deterministic pagination
Reconcile independent model count, distinct CanonicalKey set and required key-set hash
Create complete CSV and HTML with native data operations
Archive the continually updated register and a committed immutable printable monthly artifact with provenance in the approved SharePoint library
Stop for distribution approval while recipients or schedule are unapproved
Perform approved delivery and persist receipt; do not automatically resend ambiguous outcomes
failure_policy: Stop on failed or partial sources, refresh uncertainty, truncation or reconciliation failure. Preserve last-good archive without labelling it current. Record failure locally in the flow run; notification requires an approved destination. Ambiguous delivery requires reconciliation before retry.

collection: RSS: List all RSS feed items
Power BI: Run a query against a dataset (Power Query PubMed staging)
delivery: Office 365 Outlook: Send an email (V2), only after separate approval

proof_gates: SharePoint and Exchange service access and DLP
Power BI dataset query action works in My workspace with Read/Build and tenant ExecuteQueries enabled
Exact refresh completion correlation; a fixed delay does not qualify
Full RSS author and metadata parity; finite feed coverage is labelled
All query pages fit row/value/byte limits and reconcile exact canonical keys
Supported native key-set hash implementation matching publication-export.contract.json
Native M/DAX and dry-run evidence recorded

fallbacks.http_collection: Only with verified Premium/Process entitlement; otherwise Power Query staging or controlled manual import
fallbacks.refresh_completion: Manual verified completion if standard actions cannot prove the exact requested run
fallbacks.packaging: Solution-aware flow in existing eligible Dataverse environment, else ordinary cloud flow with exported package
fallbacks.report_pdf: Optional supported capacity ExportToFile; PPU is insufficient. Full CSV/HTML remain primary
fallbacks.fabric: No migration or trial dependency; only consider existing permanent capacity with approval

required: exact request identity and target match
Completed status with end time after request
frozen source/review batch identity matches refreshed model
no intervening refresh during count/key/data extraction
refresh_gate.fallback: Manual correlated history verification; stop if correlation cannot be established

checks: all response error levels empty, even HTTP 200
independent count and exact key sets match
each page progresses without duplicate keys
all 18 fields survive CSV and HTML storage readback
key-set hash matches existing contract; unsupported hash blocks unattended acceptance

monthly_printable_artifact.print_route: Power BI page print or supported capacity PDF may use this committed artifact; complete CSV/HTML remain the bibliographic evidence.

collection_dependency: Require an accepted daily-update batch, or execute and verify the same collection cycle; never assume a clock delay proves completion.
